service.method: SELECT MGL.LANGUAGE ,#DB_OWNER#GETCODETEXT1(MGL.HOUSE_CODE, 'M013',MGL.LANGUAGE,'#session.LANGUAGE#','#session.HOUSE_CODE#') LANGUAGE_NAME ,MGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC ,MGL.COMPANY_CODE ,MGL.COMPANY_NAME_ENG ,MGL.CUR ,MGL.COUNTRY ,MGL.CITY_CODE ,MGL.CITY_CODE CITY_CODE_NAME ,ADR.ADDRESS_LOC ADDRESS_LOC ,ADR.ADDRESS_ENG ADDRESS_ENG ,ADR.ZIP_CODE ZIP_CODE ,ADR.PHONE_NO1 PHONE_NO ,MGL.IRS_NO ,MGL.DUNS_NO ,ADR.HOMEPAGE HOMEPAGE ,MGL.FOUNDATION_DATE ,MGL.GROUP_COMPANY_CODE ,MGL.GROUP_COMPANY_NAME ,MGL.CREDIT_RATING ,MGL.INDUSTRY_TYPE ,MGL.INDUSTRY_TYPE INDUSTRY_TYPE_NAME ,ADR.CEO_NAME_LOC CEO_NAME ,MGL.BUSINESS_TYPE ,MGL.TRADE_AGENCY_NO ,MGL.TRADE_AGENCY_NAME ,MGL.EDI_ID ,MGL.EDI_QUALIFIER ,MGL.INS_COM_CODE FROM SCMGL MGL LEFT OUTER JOIN SADDR ADR ON MGL.HOUSE_CODE = ADR.HOUSE_CODE AND MGL.COMPANY_CODE = ADR.CODE_NO AND ADR.CODE_TYPE = 'COMPANY' WHERE 1=1 AND MGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND MGL.COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE}

SELECT CMGL.COMPANY_CODE ,CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC ,PLNT.PLANT_CODE ,PLNT.DEL_FLAG ,PLNT.PLANT_NAME_LOC ,PLNT.PLANT_NAME_ENG ,PLNT.COUNTRY ,PLNT.DEPT ,PLNT.LOGISTICS_AREA ,PLNT.IRS_NO ,PLNT.PR_LOCATION ,PLNT.INDUSTRY_TYPE ,PLNT.BUSINESS_TYPE ,PLNT.BIZ_NAME_LOC ,PLNT.BIZ_NAME_ENG ,PLNT.ATTACH_NO ,PLNT.ADD_DATE ,PLNT.ADD_TIME ,PLNT.ADD_USER_ID ,PLNT.CHANGE_DATE ,PLNT.CHANGE_TIME ,PLNT.CHANGE_USER_ID ,ADDR.ADDRESS_LOC ADDRESS_LOC ,ADDR.ADDRESS_ENG ADDRESS_ENG ,ADDR.ZIP_CODE ZIP_CODE ,ADDR.CEO_NAME_LOC CEO_NAME ,ADDR.HOMEPAGE HOMEPAGE ,ADDR.PHONE_NO1 PHONE_NO FROM SPLNT PLNT JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON PLNT.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND PLNT.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SADDR ADDR ON PLNT.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE AND PLNT.COMPANY_CODE+'_'+PLNT.PLANT_CODE = ADDR.CODE_NO AND ADDR.CODE_TYPE = 'PLANT' WHERE 1=1 AND PLNT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND PLNT.COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE} AND PLNT.PLANT_CODE = $S{PLANT_CODE}

SELECT CMGL.COMPANY_CODE ,CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC ,PLNT.PLANT_CODE ,PLNT.PLANT_NAME_LOC ,STRG.STORAGE_CODE ,STRG.STORAGE_NAME_LOC ,STRG.STORAGE_NAME_ENG ,STRG.COUNTRY ,STRG.DEPT ,STRG.LOGISTICS_AREA ,STRG.IRS_NO ,STRG.INDUSTRY_TYPE ,STRG.BUSINESS_TYPE ,STRG.BIZ_NAME_LOC ,STRG.BIZ_NAME_ENG ,ADDR.ADDRESS_LOC ADDRESS_LOC ,ADDR.ADDRESS_ENG ADDRESS_ENG ,ADDR.ZIP_CODE ZIP_CODE ,ADDR.CEO_NAME_LOC CEO_NAME ,ADDR.HOMEPAGE HOMEPAGE ,ADDR.PHONE_NO1 PHONE_NO FROM SSTRG STRG INNER JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON STRG.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND STRG.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE INNER JOIN SPLNT PLNT ON STRG.HOUSE_CODE = PLNT.HOUSE_CODE AND STRG.COMPANY_CODE = PLNT.COMPANY_CODE AND STRG.PLANT_CODE = PLNT.PLANT_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SADDR ADDR ON STRG.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE AND STRG.COMPANY_CODE+'_'+STRG.PLANT_CODE+'_'+STRG.STORAGE_CODE = ADDR.CODE_NO AND ADDR.CODE_TYPE = 'STORAGE' WHERE 1=1 AND STRG.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND STRG.COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE} AND STRG.STORAGE_CODE = $S{STORAGE_CODE}

SELECT DEPT.HOUSE_CODE ,DEPT.COMPANY_CODE ,CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC ,DEPT.PLANT_CODE ,DEPT.DEPT ,DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC ,DEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG ,DEPT.MANAGER_NAME ,DEPT.MANAGER_POSITION ,DEPT.PR_LOCATION ,DEPT.PR_LOCATION_NAME ,DEPT.CTRL_DEPT_FLAG ,DEPT.PHONE_NO ,DEPT.FAX_NO ,DEPT.MENU_TYPE ,DEPT.WORK_TYPE ,DEPT.MENU_PROFILE_CODE ,DEPT.SIGN_ATTACH_NO ,DEPT.PARENT_DEPT ,DEPT.MANAGER_ID ,DEPT.DPC ,DEPT.DPTSNA ,DEPT.DPTCNA ,DEPT.DPTCL ,DEPT.DPTJL ,DEPT.SAUP FROM SDEPT DEPT JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT.DEPT = $S{DEPT}

SELECT BAGL.HOUSE_CODE ,BAGL.COMPANY_CODE ,CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC ,BAGL.CTRL_CODE ,BAGL.CTRL_NAME_LOC ,BAGL.CTRL_NAME_ENG FROM SBAGL BAGL JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON BAGL.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND BAGL.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND BAGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BAGL.COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE} AND BAGL.CTRL_CODE = $S{CTRL}
